# TaskSetMaxPriority

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Sets the highest priority a task may give itself; lowers its base priority if needed.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0C` SVC_MANAGETASK | `MNGTASK_SET_MAX_PRIO (3)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err TaskSetMaxPriority(Handle h, uint32_t val);
```

**Registers:** `(task, max) -> r0 status`

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | Task handle with PERM_CNTL, or -1 for the caller. |
| `val` | in | New maximum priority. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `val` is above the caller's own maximum, or `h` lacks PERM_CNTL. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `h` is not a task. |
